optum_work: At Optum Aditya built Python-based automation frameworks and reusable API libraries integrated into Jenkins/Octopus CI/CD pipelines for large-scale healthcare data validation. education: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from NIT Silchar (CGPA 8.54/10), Jul 2018 – May 2022
projects: Portfolio AI Chatbot — production-deployed RAG assistant with hybrid retrieval (FAISS + BM25 fused by Reciprocal Rank Fusion), a two-level exact-then-semantic answer cache backed by an in-memory FAISS index over cached questions, token-by-token SSE streaming, live GitHub project sync with an admin hide toggle, and a RAGAS evaluation harness. FastAPI on Render, frontend on Vercel, analytics in Postgres.

AI Codebase Tutor — an onboarding tutor for unfamiliar codebases. Agentic multi-hop investigation over any GitHub repo, with every claim cited to exact file lines or a commit SHA. Hybrid BM25 + FAISS retrieval with RRF fusion, cross-encoder reranking, symbol-level AST chunking and call-graph expansion. Also generates architecture diagrams, an onboarding walkthrough, a git-archaeology evolution doc, and a narrated tutorial video. Retrieval changes are measured with hit_rate@k, recall@k, MRR and LLM-judged faithfulness.

CareRoute — an agentic provider-matching assistant that reasons from a patient's complaint to the needed specialty, then calls tools to retrieve the clinical record and find the nearest matching providers. Implemented twice with proven behavioural parity: a hand-rolled OpenAI tool-calling loop and a LangGraph StateGraph port, pinned by an offline golden-transcript test harness. A deterministic code-level guard withholds any provider list no tool confirmed, and provider search survives upstream outages via three OpenStreetMap mirrors, a 7-day cache, and stale-if-error serving.

Email Auto-Classifier & Labeler — a layered FastAPI microservice that connects to Gmail over OAuth 2.0 and auto-labels mail into a fixed six-class taxonomy using a locally fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier distilled from GPT-4o-mini, running entirely on-device so email content never leaves the machine. Raised macro-F1 from 0.67 to 0.95 by diagnosing rare-class collapse from the confusion matrix and applying inverse-frequency class weights.

RAG Document Chatbot — multimodal, session-scoped document Q&A over PDFs, scanned pages, handwritten notes and photos. A per-page router reads trustworthy text layers directly and sends scanned or corrupted pages to a vision LLM, including a trust check that catches the broken-glyph failure mode of Indic-script PDFs. Structure-aware vision extraction preserves table row and column labels for retrieval. Nothing is persisted: each session gets its own in-memory FAISS index.

Voice Travel Planner — a voice-first, multi-user travel planner that runs a guided spoken conversation, captures each participant's interests separately, and generates a balanced itinerary only after everyone has contributed. Deliberately separates LLM tasks from deterministic ones: group ranking is frequency aggregation and duration parsing is plain code, so the predictable parts never depend on a model.
Email Spam Classifier — TF-IDF n-grams + Logistic Regression with class balancing, beating a Naive Bayes baseline, served in real time via Flask.
